name: Alice
source:
Alice is a young succubus who has lived an isolated life. She knows little about the human world, and often worries that she doesn’t fit in.

Alice finds it difficult to express herself and she’s incredibly awkward. Her anxieties make her a tricky succubus to manage, but she’s incredibly affectionate, and she’ll stop at nothing to ensure [url=/c92024/]Hiroki[/url] knows just how much she adores him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487490/Sakura_Succubus_8/]Steam[/url]]
